ValidationRule.description: HRP-11899 : Implement Backend Validations for Cancelled or Rejected DCRs (DCR and DOC Sync Flow)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(sked_Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(sked_Status__c), "Rejected") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, "Approved by System"), ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, "Approved") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If a Drive Change Request is in 'Cancelled' or 'Rejected' status, it cannot be changed to an 'Approved' or 'Approved By System' status.
